description: Make a pane the active pane of its window. zoom sets the window's zoom, it never toggles: true zooms the window on this pane (or keeps it zoomed there), false unzooms it, and without zoom the window keeps its zoom state, moved to this pane. A window with one pane can't zoom: the answer says zoomed false. Like tmux itself, every client looking at that window follows, your terminal included. It does not change the session's current window (tmux::windows::select does).

zoom.description: true zooms the window on this pane, false unzooms it, absent keeps the window's zoom.

pane_id.description: Pane id now active in its window.

session_id.description: Session id the pane was resolved in.

zoomed.description: The window is zoomed on the active pane.
